text: Muñño an Nulaaɗo, e ko yimɓe maa ɓen fennete kon, wano yimɓe pellital ɓen ka Nulaaɓe muññornoo non: ɓen woni Nuuhu, e Ibraahiima, e Muusaa e Iisaa (yo ɓe his); wata a hawjiramɓe lepte. Ñalnde ɓe yi'oyta lepte ɗe ɓe kambirananoo ɗen laakara, ɓe wa'oyay wa si ɓe ñiiɓaano aduna, si wanaa dumunna-hun ñalorma, hakke ko lepte ɗen juutanta ɓe. Awa ndee Alqur'aanaare jippinaa-nde e Muhammadu (yo o his) no yoini e yimɓe e jinna. Haray non, halkiroytaake lepte, si wanaa yaltirnooɓe ɓen e ɗoftaare Allah nden, geddi e keeferaaku.
